generator_cmd: printf %s "$plain" | xxd -p -c0 | tr a-f A-F | sed 's/^/obase=64; ibase=16; /' | BC_LINE_LENGTH=0 bc | awk '{A=ENVIRON["ALPHA"]; for(i=NF;i>=1;i--) printf "%s", substr(A, $i+1, 1)}'  # GNU bc radix-64 digit groups -> ALPHA="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/" (digits reversed)
oracle_cmd: .venv/bin/python -I -c "import sys,base58;t=sys.stdin.read().rstrip('\\n');A=sys.argv[1];t=t[::-1] if sys.argv[2]=='little' else t;n=base58.b58decode_int(t.encode(),alphabet=A.encode());b=n.to_bytes((n.bit_length()+7)//8,sys.argv[3]);print(b.decode())" "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/" little big  # pip base58 2.1 b58decode_int(alphabet=A) over len(A) radix
